description.narrative:
The UNESCO – Walnut Youth Innovation Project supports the International Decade of Sciences for Sustainable Development (IDSSD) by fostering international collaboration and youth engagement in digital innovation.
Global Partnership Engagement and Visibility The project will support the operation of the Secretariat of the Science Decade. Further, the project will engage partners through relevant international forums, regional meetings, and awareness-raising initiatives, promoting multi-stakeholder dialogue with the engagement of youth within the broader framework of the Science Decade.
Youth Coding and Innovation Challenge The project will launch an international youth coding competition focused on developing AI-related skills and promoting creative digital problem-solving. The initiative is intended to encourage the participation of youth from diverse backgrounds, with particular attention to youth in the Global South. It will serve as a platform to showcase emerging talent and foster global exchange.
These activities will enhance the visibility of IDSSD and enhanced digital literacy and engagement among young people, supporting inclusive participation in the global science and technology ecosystem.
